resources.string: Manage Play Integrity, game profiles and TrickyStore compatibility. Based on AxionOS. Photos keeps its existing PixelOS configuration. Results depend on Google’s current checks.
Import an Axion game-props JSON file to select the device identity used by each listed game. Restart the game after changing its profile.

Select apps that can use your imported keybox. Enter one package per line: automatic mode by default, ? for certificate replacement, or ! for software generation. JSON target lists are also supported. Changes apply to the primary user.
Import your keybox XML or base64-encoded XML. It is stored privately and supplied only to the selected apps. No keybox is bundled. Removing it restores native certificate handling.
Optional system, vendor and boot dates for the selected TrickyStore apps. This changes their attestation profile; it does not install security updates.
Configuration saved. Restart your phone to apply all changes.
Import a JSON or prop profile
Profile disabled. Restart your phone to apply the change.
Saved %1$s profile. Restart your phone to apply it.
